sentences.text: Nyx, a 7-year-old female Domestic Shorthair, neuter status not recorded, carries a live flag for possible foreign material: the AI photo read of the May 23 vomit noted a possible plastic fragment, unconfirmed, and the photo was not retained.
Vomiting was logged on 4 of the 7 days to Jun 30, and on 23 of 43 logged days over at least 47 days, first logged May 14, her first entry of any kind, so onset is unknown.
She is free-fed Nature's Variety Duck and Royal Canin Weight Care, which lists chicken, with intake not directly observed, and no food could be isolated, with chicken in her all-day kibble.
The window was logged on 4 of the first 45 days and 39 of the last 45, with nothing logged Jul 1 to 2.
